name: Science (AAAS)
notes: Science column widths are narrow (55 mm); charts at this width get a single-column plot area and the horizontal gutter is reduced by the layout engine rather than by shrinking type.
source: Science (AAAS) information for authors, 'Figures and tables' (https://www.science.org/content/page/instructions-authors): 1 column 5.5 cm, 2 columns 12 cm, 3 columns 18.3 cm; sans-serif (Helvetica) labels. Widths from the guideline; pt/margins/height are working values (see param_source).

font_sizes_pt.detail: rounded working sizes clamped to contract floors

palette_id.detail: Okabe-Ito CVD-safe palette, not an AAAS-mandated scheme
